blocks.text: Ultrasound imaging is extensively used across various medical specialties for diagnostic purposes. In obstetrics, it helps monitor fetal growth, estimate gestational age, and identify abnormalities during pregnancy. In the abdominal region, ultrasound is used to examine vital organs such as the liver, kidneys, gallbladder, pancreas, and bladder. In cardiology, echo cardiography allows doctors to evaluate the heart's structure and function in real time. The field of urology also benefits from ultrasound for examining the prostate, testicles, and urinary system. Additionally, in the musculoskeletal system, it aids in detecting ligament injuries, joint inflammation, and other soft tissue conditions.
